description: Source code for tunnel interface setup and management in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for initializing tunnels, setting IP addresses, and handling network interface callbacks.

methods.name: is_tunnel
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is a tunnel based on its link layer.

methods.name: iface_cb
methods.description: Callback function to identify and assign tunnel interface.

methods.name: setup_iface
methods.description: Configures IP address for a network interface based on provided address string.

methods.name: init_tunnel
methods.description: Initializes and configures a virtual tunnel interface with peer address and MTU.
